items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: Einspruch gegen diesen Bußgeldbescheid können Sie innerhalb von zwei Wochen nach seiner Zustellung einlegen.
items.computation: Page 2 shows a Postzustellungsurkunde (formal delivery) with the delivery date handwritten as 08.11.2025 (Saturday). For formal delivery the date on the envelope is the delivery day itself; no days are added (§ 182 ZPO). Under §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB (applied via § 43 StPO/§ 67 OWiG), the day of delivery is not counted and the two-week period ends on the day of the second following week that bears the same name as the delivery day, i.e. a Saturday: 08.11.2025 + 2 weeks = 22.11.2025 (Saturday). Since the deadline for an Einspruch must end on a working day (§ 43 Abs. 2 StPO / § 222 Abs. 2 ZPO), and both 22.11.2025 (Sat) and 23.11.2025 (Sun) are non-working, the period moves to the next working day: Monday 24.11.2025.

items.title: Pay the total fine amount once the notice is final
items.quote: Sobald der Bescheid rechtskräftig ist, haben Sie für die Zahlung des Gesamtbetrags zwei Wochen Zeit; geben Sie als Verwendungszweck bitte das Aktenzeichen an.
items.computation: The Bescheid becomes rechtskräftig (final) upon expiry of the Einspruch period on 24.11.2025 (assuming no Einspruch is filed). Treating the expiry of that period as the triggering event, the day it expires (24.11.2025, a Monday) is not counted (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB by analogy) and the new two-week payment period starts the next day, ending on the day of the second following week bearing the same name as the triggering day (Monday): 24.11.2025 + 2 weeks = 08.12.2025 (Monday). This day is not a Saturday, Sunday or NW public holiday, so no further shift applies. This date depends on the notice actually becoming final on 24.11.2025 (i.e. no Einspruch filed), so confidence is medium.

warnings: The payment due date (2025-12-08) assumes the notice becomes final on 24.11.2025 because no Einspruch is filed by then; if an Einspruch is filed, the payment obligation and its deadline no longer apply as stated.

The letter and its attached delivery slip use obviously fictitious/placeholder place names ("Musterbergen", "Am Mühlbach 2") and a template-style IBAN — double-check that the sender, address and IBAN match a real, verifiable Regierungspräsidium before making any payment.
